text:
Assistant A provides results in the requested format (lowercase words, comma-separated, each on a new line) and correctly sorts them by descending count. Although the counts are not perfectly accurate (the paragraph contains “Amazon” 7 times, “river” 5 times, and “you” once), Assistant A’s numbers are closer to the true values and the presentation follows the user’s instructions. Assistant B uses incorrect capitalization, fails to sort by frequency, and its counts are further off. Therefore, Assistant A is the better response.

[[A]]
